title: Monthly spend sync — 1:1 prep (scratchpad)
content:
Quick notes for my 1:1 with Priya (finance lead) — use this as my talking script and the scratch area to drop numbers + action items. Rough, expect edits after the sync.

Meeting context / objective:
- Weekly 1:1 to escalate any procurement decisions that need Priya sign-off and align on near-term run-rate posture for engineering procurement.
- Goal: get final decision on 3 pending POs, confirm temporary budget reprioritization for infra burst capacity, and agree on a 2-week sprint to clear low-impact subscriptions.

Attendees (planned):
- Priya Menon (Finance lead) — decision authority
- Me (Jordan) — ops owner; will drive follow-up
- Optional: Evan (procurements) if Priya wants line-item details

Top talking points / one-liners to open with:
- "We are tracking +6% month-over-month on committed spend due to two new infra bursts and a delayed savings rollout. I want to triage 3 procurement items and lock a temporary buffer for Dedicated capacity scaling until next forecasting cycle."
- "There are three POs that need approval (small-medium) and a set of recurring subscriptions we can pause to free ~80k ARR if needed."

Current snapshot (numbers pulled from quick sheet at 2025-06-09):
- June projected burn (run-rate annualized): $49.8M annualized -> ~4.15M/month equivalent (note: this is a rolling projection not final).
- Var vs prior month: +6% (+$250k) driven by GPUs (infra burst) and third-party telemetry license bump.
- Near-term cash buffer target: keep 3 weeks runway cushion for hiring + infra.

Procurement items needing sign-off (brief):
1) PO-4821: Specialized GPU node procurement (vendor: AsterCloud) — $165k one-time, 6-month term support.
   - Business case: required to meet Dedicated capacity SLA for customer X.
   - Risk: delays push customers to fall back to alternate vendors; cost higher than quote but need immediate capacity.
   - My ask: approve now; finance to record as committed capex.
2) Subscription: TelemetryPro annual renewal — $48k/year (auto-renew pending).
   - Usage spikes observed; but can we negotiate quarterly pause for lower staging usage?
   - My ask: approve conditional renewal pending conversation with vendor for staging discount.
3) Consulting block: Infra optimization retainer (vendor: ByteShift) — $32k/month for 2 months.
   - Business case: expected to deliver batching + KV-cache changes to reduce token cost by ~12% in peak workloads.
   - My ask: greenlight 1 month trial then review metrics.

Proposed immediate decisions from Priya:
- Approve PO-4821 as committed for Dedicated delta (need PO number and cost center).
- Allow TelemetryPro renewal but instruct Evan to open discount negotiation and flag back within 5 business days.
- Approve ByteShift 1-month trial (cap spend at $35k) and require simple success metric: 8–10% token cost reduction on sample workload.

Run-rate mitigation options (things I can execute this week):
- Pause non-critical subscriptions (list in quick sheet) — expected ~80k/year savings if paused.
- Turn off non-prod autoscaling during low hours for 2 weeks (ops change) -> estimate $20–30k savings in month.
- Delay non-essential hiring reqs mapped to Q3 (need headcount approval).

Open questions I need Priya to answer / confirm:
- If we approve PO-4821, which GL account should it hit? Capex vs opex split? (my preference: capex with 12-month amortization).
- Approval threshold: can Priya approve up to $200k this week or do we need VP sign-off?
- Contingency: if TelemetryPro does not accept staging discount, can we auto-grant a downgrade to a feature-limited tier?

Risk flags to call out quickly:
- Customer X SLA: risk of miss if GPU nodes delayed >10 business days. Potential revenue impact large (>100k ARR per missed milestone).
- Accidental double-commit: engineering has one more PO in draft for same vendor — need to reconcile before invoice.

Notes to self / lines I want to say verbatim:
- "If we can greenlight the GPU PO and the ByteShift trial, I can deliver a 6–8 week plan to reduce per-token spend that offsets the one-time cost. Without the GPU, we lose predictability for Dedicated customers."
- "I will own vendor negotiation for TelemetryPro and surface concessions as they come; no auto-approve without your sign-off."

Action items to capture live in meeting (placeholders):
- ACTION: Priya — approve PO-4821 by EOD 6/12 or escalate to VP finance (owner: Priya, due: 2025-06-12).
- ACTION: Jordan/Evan — open TelemetryPro negotiation thread and document concessions (owner: Jordan, due: 2025-06-17).
- ACTION: Jordan — spin up 1-month ByteShift trial and provide initial telemetry baseline (owner: Jordan, due: 2025-06-19).
- ACTION: Evan — validate no duplicate GPU PO exists in procurement queue (owner: Evan, due: 2025-06-11).

Prep checklist (what to have on screen):
- Quick sheet with June run-rate and month-to-month variance (tab: snapshot).
- Line-item PO docs for PO-4821 and ByteShift SOW.
- TelemetryPro invoice + usage report (last 90 days).
- Slack thread link to customer X escalation (copy link in meeting).

Post-meeting follow-up template (to send after sync):
- Short note confirming decisions, list of action owners and due dates, and a link to the shared folder with artifacts.
- Tag Priya + Evan and request approval receipts or VP escalation if needed.

Back-of-envelope notes for alternatives (if Priya pushes back):
- Option A: Defer GPU PO and request temporary capacity from cloud partner at 20% premium — short-term higher unit cost but avoids committed capex.
- Option B: Approve ByteShift trial only; use their optimization to reduce telemetry spend and push deferred capex for next cycle.

Misc scratch points / questions to remember:
- Should we classify ByteShift trial as operating expense to keep balance sheet cleaner? (ask accounting).
- Confirm whether TelemetryPro has a 30-day cancellation window for staging-only contracts.
- Follow up with SRE on impact of non-prod autoscale pause (possible incident window).

End of scratchpad. Will clean after meeting and upload finalized action list to shared_drives/company/finance after Priya confirms.

-- Jordan
